title: Frog in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='10' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='10' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='6' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='6' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 44 Q50 54 64 44' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='1.8' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='1.8' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='4' fill='#F48FB1'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='40' r='4' fill='#F48FB1'/>
  <!-- scarf wrapped around neck -->
  <path d='M24 52 Q50 62 76 52 L76 60 Q50 70 24 60 Z' fill='#E53935'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='5' fill='#B71C1C'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M64 66 L78 78 L72 84 L58 72 Z' fill='#E53935'/>
  <path d='M78 78 L72 84 L70 80 Z' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='82' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#43A047'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='82' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#43A047'/>
  <!-- feet toes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='86' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='88' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='86' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='86' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='88' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='86' r='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
</svg>
